approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 8 Chapter 415

      MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 9902-A, entitled:

    "AN  ACT  to amend the social services law, in relation to codifying
        the early childhood advisory council"

    APPROVED

  The New York State Early Childhood Advisory Council (ECAC) was  estab-
lished  in  2009  to  provide  advice and guidance on issues relating to
young children and their families. The ECAC is  comprised  of  represen-
tatives  from  state  agencies, advocacy groups, unions, and foundations
with expertise in education, health  care,  child  welfare,  and  family
support.

  This  bill  would  codify the ECAC, which is a natural extension of my
Administration's  commitment  to  ensure  that  all  children  have  the
resources necessary to thrive physically, emotionally, and academically.
Specifically,  it  would  identify  the ECAC's membership, expressly set
forth the ECAC's responsibilities, and establish reporting requirements.
The Legislature has agreed to pass legislation in the  upcoming  session
that  would  further  clarify  how  the ECAC should transition new board
members, as well as correct minor drafting errors. On that basis,  I  am
signing this bill.

  This bill is approved.                      (signed) ANDREW M. CUOMO

                                ______

summary: Codifies the early childhood advisory council to promote a comprehensive and high quality early childhood system.
title: Codifies the early childhood advisory council
